# CrowdSpark - Interactive Live Quizzes & AI-Powered Audience Engagement Platform

> CrowdSpark is a modern, real-time web platform for hosting gamified live quizzes, interactive assessments, and polls with instant AI question generation, live synchronized countdowns, real-time leaderboards, and detailed analytics exports.

## Quick Facts
- **Website**: https://crowdspark.nishantmunjal.com
- **Product Type**: Interactive Live Quiz & Polling Web Application
- **Creator / Developer**: Nishant Munjal (https://nishantmunjal.com)
- **Target Audience**: Educators, University Professors, Corporate Trainers, Event Hosts, Team Leads, Students.
- **Participation Method**: Zero installation, zero friction. Participants join via 6-digit game PIN or QR code scanning on any mobile or desktop browser.
- **Hosting Model**: Cloud-hosted, web-based, real-time WebSockets synchronization.

## Core Capabilities & Features

### 1. Instant AI Quiz Generator
- Generate complete multi-question quizzes from any text prompt, topic, subject, or pasted article.
- Configurable difficulty levels (Easy, Medium, Hard) and question counts (1 to 20).
- Automatically produces accurate answer keys, multiple options, and educational explanations.

### 2. Live Synchronized Multiplayer Engine
- Real-time question synchronization across all joined participants via WebSockets.
- Configurable question timer (10s, 20s, 30s, 60s, 90s).
- Live response aggregation charts displayed to the host in real-time as answers arrive.

### 3. Gamification & Leaderboards
- Speed-based and accuracy-based score calculation.
- Dynamic streak multipliers (bonus points for consecutive correct answers).
- Live podium display after each question and at final quiz completion.

### 4. Deep Analytics & Export
- Real-time host control panel with per-question accuracy breakdowns.
- One-click export to CSV / Excel spreadsheet format for grading and attendance tracking.
- Session replay and historical quiz logs.

### 5. Multi-Device & Mobile-First
- Responsive, low-latency client optimized for smartphones, tablets, laptops, and projectors.
- Dark mode and light mode visual themes.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### How is CrowdSpark different from Kahoot or Quizizz?
CrowdSpark provides a modern, fast, ad-free experience with built-in AI quiz generation, free unlimited participants for community hosts, and instant CSV export without restrictive paywalls.

### Do students or players need accounts?
No. Participants only provide a nickname and the 6-digit game PIN or scan the on-screen QR code to play immediately.

### What login options are available for hosts?
Hosts can authenticate via Google One-Tap/OAuth, Email with Password, or Passwordless One-Time Password (OTP) sent to their email.
